newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: PX50 index closes PSE session at yr-high.
newsitem.headline: PX50 index closes PSE session at yr-high.

text.p: The Prague Stock Exchange closed at a 52-week high on Friday, spurred by foreign buying of blue chip issues, dealers said.
SPT Telecom, CEZ and Komercni Banka -- the PSE's three largest issues -- all gained ground as the PX50 index rose 8.4 points to 599.7.
Komercni led the way, jumping 151 crowns to 2,645, while utility CEZ finished another session higher, firming 20 crowns to 1,230.

"CEZ has grown strongly over the last month thanks to strong interest from foreign investors," said Bram Burning of the Brno Broker Group. "In comparison with other European power generators, CEZ is still sell at an attractive P/E," he added.
Overall volume was heavier with 1.56 million shares changing hands on turnover of 1.78 billion crowns.
Dealers said, however, that many prices, including CEZ, were nearing a peak, and the bourse may now level off on a round of profit-taking.
